WITH department_counts AS (
  SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.department
),
shares AS (
  SELECT department, member_count,
         CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM department_counts
)
SELECT department, member_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
